description: Adds structured parts to a LiveDoc and returns the created parts. Use valid LiveDoc part types and read existing content with `getDocumentParts` first; use `overwriteDocumentParts` only when replacing the full structure. Effect: creates a new resource. Repeating this call may create additional resources; it is not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

content.description: Editable only for normal and table document parts.

landscape.description: Whether the page break switches to landscape orientation. Applicable to: pagebreak parts.

layout.description: Rendering layout index for the part. Applicable to: workitem parts.

level.description: Outline level/depth of the part in the document hierarchy. Applicable to: heading, workitem parts.

sequence.description: Sequence identifier for table of figures entry. Applicable to: tof parts.

type.description: Possible values: heading, normal, pagebreak, table, toc, tof, wikiblock, workitem. Required for creation.

wikiText.description: Wiki markup content for the block. Applicable to: wikiblock parts.

spaceId.description: The Document Space ID (a folder-like grouping of documents/pages within a project). Use `_default` (no quotes) to address the project's default space.

name: postDocumentParts
